column3: Ahhh, what a lovely breeze! Hopefully it'll be smooth sailing from here.
One time, we found an isle that was worth a fortune, but on the way back, we were attacked by thralls. There were so many of them, we had no choice but to cut the isle loose...
With you and yours here, though, I'm sure we can handle anything!
*Naglfar* has come into sight, so we're making solid progress, but there's still a fair way to go.
To pass the time, I might try crafting a new kind of runework based on the curious things in your possession!
The end of the voyage is nigh! Behold our home, the realmship of water─*Naglfar*!
Soon, we'll have to make the preparations to hand off the isle. While we see to that, you and your friends can get ready to board *Naglfar*!
